summary: Unreal entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Unreal
entries.definitive_edition: Unreal Gold with OldUnreal 227 patch, with source and patch state documented

emulation.notes: Use native PC with OldUnreal patch; document any compatibility wrapper.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Windows CD or patched Unreal Gold on modern PC

primary.why: Unreal is distinct from Unreal Tournament and is no longer a normal storefront purchase route. The best practical preservation route is Unreal Gold with the Epic-permitted OldUnreal installer/227 patch, while original boxed media remains the historical artifact.
primary.how_to_play: Use Unreal Gold through an owned copy or OldUnreal's full-game installer/patch route. Record installer/source, 227 patch version, renderer, resolution, input, single-player route, Return to Na Pali inclusion, and whether original CD media was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if preserving exact 1998 media and patch state.
secondary.why: OldUnreal Gold is the practical modern route, but original media is the launch artifact.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record OldUnreal patch, renderer, installer/source, and whether Return to Na Pali is included.
